verdict.gold_reason: Article 8(4) of Regulation 2019/943 states that derogations from the 15-minute imbalance settlement period may be granted only until 31 December 2024. It also says that from 1 January 2025 the period may not exceed 30 minutes where all regulatory authorities within a synchronous area have granted an exemption. This matches the reference answer.

other_articles.why: It sets a 15-minute imbalance settlement period and allows exemptions for a synchronous area. It gives no 31 December 2024 end date, only a cost-benefit review at least every three years.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question says 'a country's regulators', but Article 8(4) also provides for exemptions granted by all regulators of a synchronous area. The date still points clearly to Article 8(4). Article 53 of the balancing guideline could be read as an alternative source, but it gives no end date.
